assets.import_path.description: The one import for any robot or asset file: USD, URDF, xacro, SDF (Gazebo), MuJoCo MJCF (.xml), a mesh prop (glTF, GLB, OBJ, STL, FBX, PLY), a ROS map (.yaml, as walls), or a folder that holds one. format=auto picks it from the name; a folder names its own entry file, or the refusal lists the candidates. Xacro and SDF are converted on the host, never by running their code. Under an approved root or a pack; sources never change. Robot formats take fixed_base and default_drives. A USD reports its drawn `visuals`; none is a warning. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

session_id.description: Exact session_id from sim__stage__info (call it first; process incarnation).

stage_id.description: Exact stage_id from sim__stage__info (call it first); stale stages are refused.

source_path.description: Absolute path of the file, or of a folder that holds one, inside an approved root or a pack version of your asset root. Or use root_id with relative_path.

root_id.description: Approved root ID from assets__roots, with relative_path, instead of source_path.

relative_path.description: Path of the file or folder inside that root.

prim_path.description: New absolute wrapper prim path; parent must exist.

format.description: auto (default): from the file name, or from what the folder holds. Or usd, urdf, xacro, sdf, mjcf, mesh, map to say it.

xacro_args.description: For xacro: values for its $(arg name), e.g. {"ur_type": "ur10e"}. Names the file declares are in the result.

sdf_model.description: For an SDF with several models (a Gazebo world): the model to import. Left out, a refusal lists them.

fixed_base.description: Robot formats: fix the base to the world. Default: true for URDF and xacro; the model's own setting for SDF (a static model); the file's own for MJCF. Pass false for a robot that drives or walks.

joint_targets.description: Robot formats: start in a pose. {joint name: radians, or stage units for a sliding joint}, set as drive targets; unknown names are listed in the warnings.

scale.description: Mesh files: multiply the size (the file's unit to metres, e.g. 0.001 for millimetres). Default 1: metres.

up_axis.description: Mesh files: the file's own up axis, y or z. Default auto: glTF, GLB, FBX and OBJ are Y-up, STL and PLY Z-up; the result is Z-up.

as_collider.description: Mesh files: none (default, looks only), convex_hull or convex_decomposition collision shapes.

wall_height.description: ROS map (.yaml): wall height in metres. Default 1.

mass.description: Mesh files: kilograms; makes it a dynamic rigid body (with a convex hull collider unless you pick one).

default_drives.description: Author drives that hold a pose. URDF, xacro, SDF: default true (they have none). MJCF: default false; true gives joints with no drive (torque motors) a generic holding drive. Wheels and casters stay free.

position.description: Three finite coordinates in stage units. Omit it for a robot format: the robot is then raised out of any ground plane (up to 3 m); a given position is used as is, with a warning if it starts inside the ground. USD files go to the origin.

assets.packs.description: List the asset packs in the asset root. Every <id>/<version> pack in the asset root (ISAAC_MCP_ASSET_ROOT, else <workspace>/assets) with its file count, size and whether it verifies against its pack.yaml, and any old-format pack with a hint to convert it with adopt. Host side, no Kit, no USD parser. Writes nothing. Kit reads its own settings: give host and Kit the same ISAAC_MCP_ASSET_ROOT. With a Kit connected it also lists kit_environment and warns when Kit and this host use a different asset root or project file.

assets.pack_doctor.description: Check a pack without changing it. Every file listed in pack.yaml exists and matches its sha256, nothing unlisted or symlinked is in the folder, then the dependencies of its USD, URDF, MJCF, SDF, mesh and map files must all be files of the same pack (unresolved, unreadable, remote and outside-pack references are problems). Parses USD in a host helper (ISAAC_MCP_USD_PYTHON) or else the selected Kit; says so if neither ran, and ok is then false. A URDF's own references are read on the host.

pack.description: Pack as "<pack id>/<version>". Default: the project file's pack.

fields.name: pack
fields.description: Pack as "<pack id>/<version>". Default: the project file's pack.

assets.dependencies.description: Compute dependency closures for files under an approved root or the asset root. USD uses UsdUtils.ComputeAllDependencies through a host helper (ISAAC_MCP_USD_PYTHON) or else the selected Kit; native USD parsing is NOT sandboxed. A .urdf is read on the host with the build's package rules and returns its meshes, textures and package.xml, so a missing package is reported instead of a parser error. Copies nothing.

paths.description: Absolute USD or URDF file paths, 1 to 64.

fields.name: paths
fields.description: Absolute USD or URDF file paths, 1 to 64.

assets.pack_adopt.description: Copy a folder into a new pack version. Copies a folder's asset files into a NEW pack version <id>/<version> in the asset root and write its pack.yaml (sha256 of every file, plus the source and license you give; redistributable is false unless you say so). The source must be under a user-approved root. A version that exists is never modified: give a new one. Symlinks are never followed. With from_old, converts an old-format pack folder of the asset root into <id>/v1, leaving the old files in place.

pack.description: The new pack as "<pack id>/<version>", for example my-robot/v1.

source.description: Where the files came from, one line (a vendor, repository URL and commit, or file hash). Recorded for every file.

license.description: The licence or terms, one line (for example "private lab use only"). Recorded for every file.

source_path.description: Absolute folder under an approved root. Give this or from_old.

from_old.description: Name of an old-format pack folder in the asset root to convert; pack must be <that name>/<version>.

redistributable.description: The files may be redistributed. Default false.

files.description: Copy only these files or folders, relative to source_path. A named file is copied whatever its type.

dry_run.description: Report the plan and write nothing.

assets.pack_pin.description: Rewrite the sha256 values of an existing pack.yaml to match its files, and show what changed. A version that already verifies is not modified. A changed hash accepts whatever bytes are there, so it is refused with before and after hashes unless the file is named in files or force=true. Missing or unlisted files cannot be fixed by a hash: write a new version with adopt or build.

files.description: Pin only these relative paths, accepting their changes.

dry_run.description: Show what would change and write nothing.

assets.pack_build.description: Copy asset files and their dependencies into a new pack version. USD, URDF, MuJoCo XML, SDF, mesh or ROS map files and only what they depend on go into a NEW pack version in the asset root, keeping layout, and write its pack.yaml. A file copied out of from_pack keeps that pack's source, license and redistributable; any other file needs source and license. Sources must be under an approved root or the asset root. Unresolved or remote references refuse the build unless allow_unresolved=true. An existing version is never modified. For xacro use assets__import_path.

pack.description: Destination as "<pack id>/<version>"; the version must not exist.

sources.description: USD, URDF, MJCF (.xml), SDF, mesh or map (.yaml) files, 1 to 64: absolute paths, or paths inside from_pack. A USD scene outside from_pack and layout_root is read for its references and not copied.

license.description: Licence or terms of those files, one line.

redistributable.description: Those files may be redistributed. Default false.

allow_unresolved.description: Build despite missing or remote references, and record them in pack.yaml.
